item.title: "Old Friend, It's Time for You to Return Home"... The Resolute Order from President Syngman Rhee Across the Pacific (“자네, 이제 귀국하게”… 태평양 건너 이승만 대통령의 단호한 지시)
item.description:
"Old Friend, It's Time for You to Return Home"... The Resolute Order from President Syngman Rhee Across the Pacific (“자네, 이제 귀국하게”… 태평양 건너 이승만 대통령의 단호한 지시)

The next morning, Paik Sun-yup visited the U.S. State Department and met with Walter Smith, the Deputy Under Secretary whom President Eisenhower had mentioned. According to accounts, they exchanged views on the impending armistice, the economic reconstruction of a Korea ravaged by war, and various matters of security. It was a remarkably fortuitous "convergence." An unplanned meeting with the U.S. President had taken place, and likewise, there had been an unplanned request from Paik Sun-yup for a "defense treaty." Finally, following Eisenhower's remark that he "agreed in principle," there was also the recommendation to meet with Smith. <<> As later became known, General Mark Clark, the Commander-in-Chief of the United Nations Command in Tokyo, reportedly received a cable from Washington around that time. It is said to have read: "From now on, place the matter of a mutual defense treaty with Korea on the table and negotiate it officially." It was a message that the discussions on the ROK-U.S. Mutual Defense Treaty, which until then had been conducted covertly or in top secrecy, could now proceed openly. At the time, the armistice negotiations with the communist side were in their final stages, and it is said that the United States had finally begun a serious review of the mutual defense treaty issue with Korea around that period. <<> In that regard, Paik Sun-yup's visit to Washington is notable in many ways. Even if his remarks were not decisive, Washington, which sought to finalize the armistice while formalizing the defense treaty discussions, could be seen as observing something through Paik Sun-yup, the most powerful figure in the South Korean military. <<> In that atmosphere, Paik Sun-yup completed his Washington schedule and headed to New York. First, he made an official visit to West Point. A familiar face was there. It was Michaelis, his old comrade-in-arms who, in the final stages of the "Battle of Dabudong" in August 1950, when the fate of the Republic of Korea hung in the balance, had arrived with tank units and overwhelming firepower, establishing defensive lines in the Cheonpyeong-dong valley and blocking North Korean forces on the axis of advance toward Daegu. <<> He had already been promoted to Brigadier General while serving as Commandant of Cadets at West Point. Paik Sun-yup recounted that Michaelis seemed somewhat awkward when Paik, who had been a Brigadier General during the Battle of Dabudong, appeared now with the rank of General on his shoulders. His face, handsome enough to rival a movie star, bore an expression of being moved while looking upon his proud comrade Paik Sun-yup. <<> Next, Paik Sun-yup met with the retired war hero Douglas MacArthur in New York. It was not a gathering to which MacArthur had invited him. Nor was it part of any pre-arranged official schedule. Paik Sun-yup, having simply heard that MacArthur was staying in New York, undertook a "courtesy call" on his own initiative. It is a moment that reveals Paik Sun-yup's character. <<> At the time, MacArthur did not hold Paik Sun-yup in his memory. However, he reportedly welcomed Paik Sun-yup, the Chief of Staff of the Republic of Korea Army, who had come to pay his respects to the man who had defended the Korean front lines. In the late 1950s, when Paik Sun-yup assumed the post of Chief of Staff for the second time, he again made a "courtesy call" on MacArthur, who was a few years from his passing, during a visit to the United States. He had not forgotten the grace of the man who had stood alongside him on the Korean front lines against the threat of communist subjugation. <<> Paik Sun-yup then visited the U.S. Army Infantry School at Fort Benning, Georgia, among other places. There were Korean military students there. They reportedly struggled because they had not properly mastered English. At the time, it is said that the "me too" of Korean officers studying in the U.S. was a big topic of conversation among the staff at the Infantry School. During meal times, they would line up in front of each assigned cook to receive their food, and the Korean officers, unskilled in English, would stand behind those who ordered first, and when their turn came, they would uniformly say "me too." <<> From today's perspective, it's a rather amusing anecdote, but through such trials and tribulations, the ROK military reportedly learned diligently. Overall academic performance of the Korean officers was said to have consistently been at a very high level. Next, Paik Sun-yup went to the Command and General Staff College at Fort Leavenworth, Kansas. <<> That place was the final stop on Paik Sun-yup's visit to the U.S. and, formally, the primary destination of his trip. At the Command and General Staff College, about 30 U.S. military instructors conducted an intensive, accelerated course centered on Paik Sun-yup alone. It was the highest level of education on command and staff operations for the supreme commander of the ROK military. Paik Sun-yup's training schedule had originally been set for two weeks. Due to the tightly packed schedule, he could not leisurely exchange pleasantries with the familiar colleagues who were already studying there. At that Command and General Staff College were his welcome comrades, Generals Lee Jong-chan, Chung Il-kwon, Choi Young-hee, Park Byung-kwon, and Chung Rae-hyuk. <<> Only a few days had passed, it is said. Paik Sun-yup remembered it as being less than ten days in. There was a sudden summons from President Syngman Rhee. The phone call from President Rhee, which came into the college's office, traveled across the Pacific with a calm yet somehow suggestive voice, he reportedly said. <<> President Rhee said, "Old friend, if things there aren't urgent, then just come on back." At that time, a strong cold current was flowing between Korea and the United States. Perhaps it was akin to the atmosphere just before a storm. Discussions on the ROK-U.S. Mutual Defense Treaty were on the verge of formally coming to the table, and President Syngman Rhee was expressing great dissatisfaction with the armistice that was rapidly progressing regardless of the Republic of Korea's will for unification. <<> If those signs of conflict had spread in earnest, it would have been a grave matter. It was fortunate that the summons for Paik Sun-yup was the only one. At the time, some U.S. media reported on the conflict between Korea and the U.S. administration, suggesting that "President Rhee could order the return of all Korean military officers studying in the United States." If that had happened, the conflict between the two countries would have escalated to its peak. But President Rhee only urged the return of one person: Paik Sun-yup, the Army Chief of Staff, who was visiting the United States. <<> Accordingly, Paik Sun-yup, without completing the full training schedule at the Command and General Staff College, reportedly hurriedly embarked on his journey home. It was a reversal of the route he had taken to visit the United States. He crossed the Pacific again and landed in Tokyo. From there, he had to board a military aircraft again to head to Seoul. In Tokyo, he met again with General Mark Clark, the Commander-in-Chief of the United Nations Command. Paik Sun-yup recalled that Clark said: "I convey the message from the U.S. administration that you may relay to President Syngman Rhee the contents of the conversations you have had so far regarding the mutual defense treaty." <<> Leaving Tokyo and arriving in Seoul, Paik Sun-yup went straight to Gyeongmudae to see President Syngman Rhee. However, the roads were completely blocked, it is said. The streets were filled with demonstrators. They were chanting, "Give us unification or death" and "We must drive out the Chinese communist forces from the north." That was the atmosphere in Seoul. The conflict with the United States, which sought to conclude the armistice, remained, and it was gradually growing into something enormous. <<> (이튿날 아침 백선엽은 미 국무부를 방문해 아이젠하워 미 대통령이 언급한 월터 스미스 차관보와 면담했다. 앞으로 닥칠 휴전, 전쟁으로 피폐해진 대한민국의 경제적 재건, 안보에 관한 여러 의견을 나눴다고 한다. 매우 공교로운 ‘집합’이었다. 예정에 없던 미 대통령과의 면담이 이뤄졌고, 역시 예정에 없던 백선엽의 ‘방위 조약’ 요청이 있었다. 마침내 “원칙적으로 동의한다”는 아이젠하워 언급에 이어 스미스를 만나보라는 권유도 있었다.)

item.title: Despite South Korea's Opposition... UNC Launches Brigade Merging Armistice Commission and Guard Battalion (한국 반대에도… 유엔사, 정전위·경비대대 통합한 여단 출범)
item.description:
Despite South Korea's Opposition... UNC Launches Brigade Merging Armistice Commission and Guard Battalion (한국 반대에도… 유엔사, 정전위·경비대대 통합한 여단 출범)

The United Nations Command (UNC), led by the United States, has carried out an internal organizational restructuring that merges the "Military Armistice Commission," which manages approvals for entry into the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), with the "UNC Guard Battalion," responsible for guarding the Joint Security Area (JSA) at Panmunjom, elevating them into a "Guard and Armistice Enforcement Brigade," it was reported on the 13th. The South Korean government, which has been at odds with the UNC over jurisdiction over the DMZ since last year, is known to have repeatedly opposed this organizational change. <<> According to military sources on the 13th, the UNC recently launched the Guard and Armistice Enforcement Brigade, headed by a colonel who serves as the secretary-general of the Military Armistice Commission, which handles DMZ entry permissions, investigations into armistice violations, and liaison with North Korean forces. This is interpreted as an expansion of the role of the Military Armistice Commission secretary-general, who is responsible for implementing the Korean War Armistice Agreement, to strengthen its authority. Amid the South Korean side's continued demands for joint exercise of DMZ jurisdiction with the UNC since the Lee Jae-myung government took office, this can be seen as the UNC expressing its resolve to exercise DMZ jurisdiction more firmly. <<> Regarding this reorganization, the UNC communicated multiple times with the South Korean government through various channels, including the Ministry of National Defense and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, but the two sides remained at an impasse as the South Korean government consistently opposed the brigade upgrade. The UNC explained it as an "organizational restructuring for efficient operations," while the South Korean side is said to have expressed concerns about the strengthening of the UNC's armistice implementation functions. <<> In response, the Ministry of National Defense stated on the same day, "We cannot confirm the details of the discussions between South Korea and the UNC," adding, "Speculative reporting could have a negative impact on cooperation between the South Korea-U.S. alliance and allied nations." <<> ◇Military Said "No UNC Reorganization Will Happen"... But the Brigade Launch Is Already Complete <<> The South Korean government is known to have voiced its opposition until the very last moment against the UNC's creation of the "Guard and Armistice Enforcement Brigade," which handles DMZ entry approvals and investigations into armistice violations. A military source on the 13th said, "Minister Ahn Kyu-baek recently met with (UNC Commander) General Xavier Brunson, who also serves as the commander of U.S. Forces Korea, and had a good discussion, and it was concluded that no UNC reorganization would take place." A UNC official also said they "cannot confirm" whether the brigade had been launched. However, another military official said, "They are simply not officially confirming it out of consideration for the South Korean government's position, but I know that the UNC has already launched the Guard and Armistice Enforcement Brigade." <<> On the same day, the South Korean Ministry of National Defense stated that it was not true that "the UNC would hold a founding ceremony for the Guard and Armistice Enforcement Brigade." It is being said that the South Korean government's opposition was also behind the UNC's quiet launch of the brigade without a separate ceremony. A former senior defense official said, "Rather than coordinating their differences behind the scenes, the two sides are clinging to trivial matters like a founding ceremony and are essentially talking past each other." <<> Behind the South Korean government's opposition to the UNC's launch of the Guard and Armistice Enforcement Brigade lies the ongoing conflict over DMZ jurisdiction that has persisted since the Lee Jae-myung government took office, according to interpretations. In December of last year, Unification Minister Chung Dong-young claimed that the South Korean government's inability to approve DMZ entries was a matter of "sovereignty," and argued for the urgent passage of the "Act on Support for the Peaceful Use of the DMZ" (DMZ Act), proposed by lawmakers of the Democratic Party of Korea, which includes provisions for the Unification Minister to also exercise DMZ jurisdiction. In January, the Ministry of National Defense also demanded "divided jurisdiction" from the UNC, asking that areas south of our military's barbed wire fences within the DMZ be placed under our military's control. <<> The UNC rejected all of these demands, and in January of this year, it unusually held a press briefing to reaffirm its position that control over DMZ access is the UNC's authority under the Armistice Agreement. Regarding the DMZ Act proposed by the ruling party, the UNC even went so far as to say it would be a "direct violation of the Armistice Agreement," and that if the law passed, it would be "tantamount to the South Korean government declaring that it would not be bound by the (armistice) agreement." <<> In June, the Ministry of National Defense and the UNC clashed over whether North Korean troops' installation of barbed wire fences within the DMZ constituted a violation of the Armistice Agreement. While it is the UNC that determines whether the Armistice Agreement has been violated, the Ministry of National Defense repeatedly insisted it was a "clear violation," leading to the UNC publicly refuting that certain defensive construction on the northern side of the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) without heavy weapons could not be considered an armistice violation, and that no North Korean barbed wire or mines had crossed into the southern side. <<> Amid this situation, when the UNC sought to create the Guard and Armistice Enforcement Brigade, the South Korean side is known to have expressed concerns that the U.S. side might be preparing for the period after the wartime operational control (OPCON) transition that the Lee Jae-myung government is pursuing. Currently, General Brunson, the commander of U.S. Forces Korea, also serves as both the UNC commander and the commander of the South Korea-U.S. Combined Forces Command (CFC), but after the OPCON transition, a four-star South Korean general will command the CFC. The concern is whether the UNC is trying to more clearly define its unique mission of managing the armistice and its independent command structure in preparation for this change in CFC command authority. In this regard, Professor Park Won-gon of Ewha Womans University said, "After the OPCON transition, the U.S. could plan to use the UNC to check China." <<> However, the UNC is said to maintain that the launch of the Guard and Armistice Enforcement Brigade is a simple internal reorganization without any increase in personnel or creation of new functions. The UNC stated on the same day, "The United Nations Command and U.S. Forces Korea routinely review their organizations to ensure resources are appropriately allocated to effectively carry out core missions," adding, "The current plans reflect only the internal reallocation of existing resources and involve absolutely no increases in personnel, infrastructure, or capabilities on the Korean Peninsula." South Korea is not one of the 18 UNC member states but holds the status of a host nation. However, the UNC is reportedly not obligated to obtain South Korea's approval regarding organizational changes. <<> There are also criticisms that repeated conflict between the Ministry of National Defense and the UNC ahead of the OPCON transition is undesirable. A former senior defense official said, "The UNC, which manages the armistice, is an institution that receives orders from the U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff," adding, "South Korea needs to understand that continuing to take a confrontational stance with the UNC also places a burden on the South Korea-U.S. alliance." (미국이 주도하는 유엔군사령부가 비무장지대(DMZ) 출입 승인 등을 관리하는 ‘군사정전위원회’와 판문점 공동경비구역(JSA) 경비 등을 담당하는 ‘유엔사 경비대대’를 통합해 ‘경비정전집행여단’으로 격상하는 내부 조직 개편을 단행한 것으로 13일 전해졌다. 지난해부터 DMZ 관할권을 두고 유엔사와 이견을 보여 온 우리 정부는 이 같은 조직 개편에 거듭 반대했던 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: North Korea claims ROK-US UFS drills "cause security instability," announces exercise of "right to self-defense" (北, 한미 UFS 훈련에 “안보 불안정 유발” 주장… “정당방위권 행사” 예고)
item.description:
North Korea claims ROK-US UFS drills "cause security instability," announces exercise of "right to self-defense" (北, 한미 UFS 훈련에 “안보 불안정 유발” 주장… “정당방위권 행사” 예고)

North Korea on the 14th condemned the ROK-US combined exercise "Ulchi Freedom Shield" (UFS) for "causing a level of security instability different from previous years," while announcing the exercise of its so-called "right to self-defense." (북한이 14일 한미 연합 훈련 ‘을지 자유의 방패’(UFS)에 대해 “예년과 다른 수준의 안보 불안정 상황을 유발하고 있다”고 비난하면서 이른바 ‘정당방위권’ 행사를 예고했다.)

In a statement by a spokesperson of the Foreign Ministry published through the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) on the same day, North Korea said, "This exercise mobilizes tens of thousands of troops and combat technical equipment, including the armed forces of the United States, South Korea, and member states of the 'United Nations Command,' and during the exercise period, outdoor maneuver drills including 'Warrior Shield,' as well as various live-fire drills simulating advanced operational environments such as drone warfare, electronic warfare, and cyber warfare, are scheduled to be carried out." (북한은 이날 조선중앙통신을 통해 발표한 외무성 대변인 담화에서 “이번 연습에는 미국과 한국, ‘유엔군사령부’ 성원국들의 무력을 포함한 수만 명의 병력과 전투 기술 기재들이 동원되며, 연습 기간 ‘워리어 실드’를 비롯한 야외 기동 훈련과 무인기전, 전자전, 사이버전과 같은 첨단 작전 환경을 가상한 각종 실전 훈련들이 강행될 예정”이라고 했다.)

UFS is an annual computer-simulation-based command post exercise conducted by the ROK and the US, scheduled to take place from the 17th to the 27th. Fourteen outdoor maneuver drills at the battalion-level or above, linked to the exercise, will also be conducted. (UFS는 한미가 연례적으로 하는 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션 기반 지휘소 연습으로, 오는 17~27일 시행된다. 이와 연계된 대대급 이상 단위의 야외 기동 훈련도 14건 실시된다.)

North Korea claimed, "The United States has made clear that this joint military exercise is distinctly different from the drills of the past five years, and that the focus of the exercise has been placed on mastering war-fighting capabilities based on new aspects of modern warfare, thereby not hiding the fact that its purpose lies in completing preparations for an actual military confrontation with our state." (북한은 “미국은 이번 합동 군사 연습이 지난 5년간의 연습들과는 명백히 다르며, 연습의 초점을 현대전의 새로운 양상에 입각한 전쟁 수행 능력 숙달에 두었다는 것을 공개함으로써, 그 목적이 우리 국가와의 실제적인 군사적 대결 준비 완성에 있다는 것을 숨기지 않았다”고 주장했다.)

It further claimed, "This amounts to an admission that this exercise, which the US and South Korea argue is 'annual' and 'defensive,' is in essence a demonstration of aggressive war." (이어 “이것은 미·한이 이른바 ‘연례적’, ‘방어적’이라고 강변하는 이번 연습이 본질상 침략 전쟁 시연이라는 것을 자인한 것이 된다”고 주장했다.)

North Korea said, "At this point when the military and political situation in the international arena is growing increasingly grave and the US abuse of power is becoming routine, the large-scale war exercise by the US and South Korea once again is causing a level of security instability different from previous years on the Korean Peninsula and in the region beyond." (북한은 “국제적 판도에서 군사 정치 정세가 날로 엄중해지고 미국의 힘의 남용이 일상화되고 있는 현 시점에 또다시 벌어지는 미·한의 대규모 전쟁 연습은 조선반도(한반도)와 그 너머의 지역에서 예년과 다른 수준의 안보 불안정 상황을 유발하고 있다”고 했다.)

North Korea particularly noted, "The aggressive posture adjustments of US armed forces being pursued in earnest on a global scale, and as part of that, the deepening strategic flexibility of US Forces Korea, the trilateral military cooperation framework of the US, Japan, and South Korea, which is morphing into a nuclear alliance, and the military buildups of Japan and South Korea, are further highlighting the danger of the UFS joint military exercise, in which all military assets and war-fighting methods held by the US and South Korea are mobilized." (북한은 특히 “전 지구적 범위에서 본격화되고 있는 미군 무력의 공격적인 태세 조정과 그 일환으로 심화되는 주한 미군의 전략적 유연성 확대, 핵 동맹으로 변이되고 있는 미·일·한 3각 군사 공조 체제와 일본과 한국의 군사력 확충은 미·한이 보유한 군사 자산들과 전쟁 수행 방식이 총동원되는 UFS 합동 군사 연습의 위험성을 보다 부각시키고 있다”고 했다.)

North Korea claimed, "Serious threats are being created to our state's security domain and the region's security environment by the aggressive war exercises of hostile states." (북한은 “적수국들의 침략 전쟁 연습으로 우리 국가의 안전 영역과 지역의 안보 환경에는 엄중한 위협이 조성되고 있다”고 주장했다.)

It added, "Applying a new level of deterrence to a new level of threat is our consistent principle of security assurance," and "The will of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea to frustrate all hostile acts from outside with the strongest and most overwhelming response capability and to absolutely defend the supreme interests of state security is firm and unwavering." (그러면서 “새로운 수준의 위협에 새로운 수준의 억제력을 적용하는 것은 우리의 일관한 안전 보장 원칙”이라며 “가장 강력하고 압도적인 대응력으로 외부로부터의 온갖 적대 행위를 좌절시키고 국가 안전의 최고 이익을 절대적으로 수호하려는 조선민주주의인민공화국의 의지는 확고부동하다”고 했다.)

North Korea said, "The serious state of force confrontation created by hostile states will not be tolerated in the slightest, and through the responsible and resolute exercise of the right to self-defense, our stance toward the enemy, which seeks to thoroughly disallow any arbitrary threats and challenges, will be expressed more clearly." (북한은 “적수국들이 조성하는 엄중한 힘의 대치 국면은 추호도 용납되지 않을 것이며, 책임적이고도 단호한 정당방위권 행사로, 임의의 위협과 도전도 철저히 불허하려는 우리의 대적 입장은 보다 명백히 표현될 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok vs. Jeong Cheong-rae in tight race — 'public opinion poll' emerges as variable (김민석·정청래 박빙 싸움 변수 ‘국민 여론조사’ 시작)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok vs. Jeong Cheong-rae in tight race — 'public opinion poll' emerges as variable (김민석·정청래 박빙 싸움 변수 ‘국민 여론조사’ 시작)

As the August 17 National Convention regional primaries to elect the next leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea show a neck-and-neck race between party leader candidates Kim Min-seok and Jeong Cheong-rae, the public opinion poll that has emerged as a key variable in determining the final outcome begins on the 14th. With the vote gap between candidates Kim and Jeong at just 1.45 percentage points, the public opinion poll accounts for 30% of the final result. (더불어민주당 차기 지도부를 뽑는 8·17 전당대회 순회 경선이 김민석·정청래 당대표 후보 간 박빙 싸움 양상을 보이면서 최종 결과를 가를 변수로 떠오른 국민 여론조사가 14일 시작된다. 김·정 후보의 득표율 차가 1.45%포인트에 그친 가운데, 국민 여론조사는 최종 결과의 30%를 차지한다.)

The Democratic Party will conduct the poll over two days from today through the 15th. The method involves calling random wireless phone numbers beginning with 010 (RDD) to request responses to the survey. To prevent so-called 'reverse selection,' only responses from those who said they support the Democratic Party or who said they have no supporting party will be reflected in the survey results. The party plans to collect more than 2,000 such responses. Responses from those who said they support other parties, such as the People Power Party, the Reform Party, or the Fatherland Innovation Party, will not be reflected. (민주당은 이날부터 15일까지 이틀간 여론조사를 시행한다. 010으로 시작하는 임의의 무선 전화번호에 전화를 걸어(RDD) 여론조사 응답을 청하는 방식이다. 이른바 ‘역선택’ 방지를 위해, 지지 정당이 민주당이라고 답한 사람과 지지 정당이 없다고 답한 사람의 응답만 조사 결과에 반영한다. 이런 응답을 2000개 이상 받을 예정이다. 국민의힘, 개혁신당, 조국혁신당 등 다른 정당을 지지한다고 답한 사람의 응답은 반영되지 않는다.)

In the party member voting results disclosed so far, candidate Kim has received 96,799.25 votes (46.00%), leading candidate Jeong, who has received 93,743.35 votes (44.55%), by 3,055.9 votes and 1.45 percentage points. Candidate Song Young-gil has received 19,902.6 votes (9.46%). This reflects the Democratic Party's decision to add a 5% bonus to votes from Daegu, North Gyeongsang, and South Gyeongsang, which the party designated as strategic regions. (지금까지 공개된 권리당원 투표에서는 김 후보가 9만6799.25표(46.00%)를 얻어, 9만3743.35표(44.55%)를 얻은 정 후보를 3055.9표, 1.45%포인트 차로 앞서고 있다. 송영길 후보는 1만9902.6표(9.46%)를 얻었다. 민주당이 전략 지역으로 정한 대구·경북·경남 득표 수에 5%를 가산하기로 한 것을 반영한 결과다.)

Public opinion poll results released so far have been mixed. In a survey conducted by Realmeter on the 9th–10th among 1,053 Democratic Party supporters and independents, candidate Kim led with 46.8% versus candidate Jeong's 35.2%, a gap of 11.6 percentage points, beyond the margin of error (±3.0 percentage points). In contrast, a survey commissioned by Newsis from Ace Research over the same period among 646 Democratic Party supporters and independents showed a tight race, with candidate Kim at 36.9% and candidate Jeong at 36.7%, a difference of just 0.2 percentage points. (지금까지 발표된 여론조사 결과는 엇갈리고 있다. 리얼미터가 지난 9~10일 민주당 지지층과 무당층 1053명을 대상으로 시행한 조사에서는 김 후보 46.8%, 정 후보 35.2%로 김 후보가 오차 범위(±3.0%포인트) 밖인 11.6%포인트 차로 앞섰다. 반면 뉴시스가 에이스리서치에 의뢰해 같은 기간 민주당 지지층과 무당층 646명을 대상으로 한 조사에서는 김 후보 36.9%, 정 후보 36.7%로 0.2%포인트 차 접전이었다.)

In a survey conducted by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research on the 10th–12th, candidate Kim led significantly among 404 Democratic Party supporters with 44% versus candidate Jeong's 25%, but among 295 independents the gap was negligible, with candidate Kim at 9% and candidate Jeong at 8%. (엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 지난 10~12일 시행한 조사에서는 민주당 지지층 404명 사이에서는 김 후보가 44%, 정 후보가 25%로 김 후보가 크게 앞섰으나, 무당층 295명 사이에서는 김 후보 9%, 정 후보 8%로 차이가 거의 없었다.)

The Democratic Party will combine the regional primary results disclosed so far, the Honam primary results to be released on the 15th, the Seoul and Gyeonggi primary results to be released on the 16th, along with the national convention delegate voting results and the public opinion poll results, to announce the winner on the 17th. (민주당은 지금까지 공개된 순회 경선 결과와 15일 공개되는 호남 경선 결과, 16일 공개되는 서울·경기 경선 결과에 전국대의원 투표 결과와 국민 여론조사 결과 등을 합산해 17일 당선자를 발표한다.)

item.title: "Trust in Real Estate Policy Is Broken" "If We Keep This Up, It's Total Collapse"... Outburst of Dissatisfaction at Ruling Party Meeting (“부동산 정책 신뢰 깨졌다” “이대로면 폭망”… 與 의총서 불만 폭발)
item.description:
"Trust in Real Estate Policy Is Broken" "If We Keep This Up, It's Total Collapse"... Outburst of Dissatisfaction at Ruling Party Meeting (“부동산 정책 신뢰 깨졌다” “이대로면 폭망”… 與 의총서 불만 폭발)

At the Democratic Party of Korea's lawmakers' meeting held on the 13th, strong criticism was raised against the government's real estate tax reform plan, led by lawmakers from the capital region. In particular, remarks such as "The president said multiple times he wouldn't control housing prices with taxes, and now trust is broken" and "If we go on like this, whether it's the general election or the presidential election, it's total collapse" were made. Concerns poured in about the negative impact of real estate sentiment on elections ahead of the 2028 general election. After the lawmakers' meeting, the party leadership said, "It's not that we oppose the government's plan entirely," while hinting at the possibility of revising and supplementing the government's tax and housing supply plans. <<> The lawmakers' meeting continued behind closed doors for over two hours, with more than ten lawmakers reportedly speaking. Most of the remarks were critical of the government's plan. It was reported that Lee Yeon-hee, chair of the party's strategy committee, and Oh Gi-hyung, the ruling party's floor secretary on the budget committee, spoke first, saying that "President Lee Jae-myung said during the last presidential election that he wouldn't control housing prices with taxes, but this policy doesn't align with that stance." Lee Yeon-hee reportedly said, "Taxation on non-resident single-homeowners has no practical effect," and "With excess tax revenue of over 50 trillion won coming in from semiconductors, the political loss of pushing through real estate taxation is too great." Lawmakers holding key party positions thus rebelled against government policy. <<> Lawmakers strongly criticized the reduction of the long-term holding special deduction benefits for non-resident single-homeowners. Jeon Hyun-hee, a lawmaker representing Seongdong-gu in Seoul, part of the Han River belt, said, "Since the government announced its tax reform plan, complaints from local residents have been pouring in," and "If we fight the Seoul mayoral election like this, we'll definitely lose." Jeon said, "Among the 3040 generation who bought their first home by stretching their finances, many can't actually reside there due to budget issues," and asked, "Isn't it too harsh to penalize non-residents?" She then argued that the government's plan to eliminate the holding period benefit from the long-term holding special deduction should be revised. <<> Seo Young-kyo, a four-term lawmaker representing Jungnang-gu Gap in Seoul, said, "In my district, there isn't a single apartment meeting the comprehensive real estate tax threshold (public assessed value of 1.4 billion won), but residents are extremely anxious," and "For one-household, one-home cases, I hope they wouldn't distinguish between residential and non-residential." Seo also said, "Residents in redevelopment areas can't move because relocation loan funds haven't come through," arguing that the loan-to-value ratio should be eased when there are reasons such as redevelopment relocation or first-time home purchases. <<> Hong Ki-won, a lawmaker representing Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi Province, said, "The government poured fuel on the already poor real estate sentiment in the capital region," and "Any citizen can become a non-resident single-homeowner due to job changes or reassignments." Other arguments included "We should increase holding taxes but reduce transaction tax burdens." Regarding the housing supply measures announced by the government that day, remarks included "The current government supply measures are insufficient. We need to dramatically expand the scale even by injecting government finances" and "The order of announcing the tax reform and supply measures was reversed." Lee So-young, a lawmaker representing Uiwang and Gwacheon in Gyeonggi Province, reportedly pointed out regarding the large-scale housing construction planned in her district, "Are they building without any plans for traffic congestion and infrastructure shortages?" <<> After the lawmakers' meeting, Heo Young told reporters, "With excess tax revenue reaching 100 trillion won, why touch taxes? If we go on like this, it's 'total collapse,'" and "This can't be pushed through as the government proposes. The president will have no choice but to accept it once the National Assembly decides." Another lawmaker who attended the meeting said, "It was an atmosphere where lawmakers spoke strongly with a sense of crisis," and "That's how much this policy doesn't make sense from the public's perspective." <<> With ruling party lawmakers collectively expressing such concerns, the government's tax reform plan is expected to undergo significant revisions in the National Assembly. Spokesperson Lee Ju-hee said, "We will do our best to craft a tax reform plan that doesn't make the public feel unjustly treated." The Democratic Party plans to continue discussions through additional lawmakers' meetings, a task force, or relevant standing committee sessions. The party also said it would reach agreement with the opposition on bills that can be processed, including housing supply-related legislation, at the National Assembly plenary session scheduled for the 20th. <<> Within the Democratic Party, arguments also emerged that the increased tax revenue from the semiconductor boom should be used for housing supply. Oh Gi-hyung, after concluding a meeting attended by Seoul district lawmakers and Seoul city council members, told reporters, "There's a view that whether it's 10 trillion won or 20 trillion won in additional tax revenue, shouldn't it be used for housing welfare and housing stability?" and "The public sector needs to play a more proactive role." Kim Young-bae, a lawmaker who has filed a sole candidacy for chair of the Seoul city party committee, also relayed, "I hear President Lee Jae-myung also spoke to the effect of 'actively devising supply measures using additional tax revenue.'" <<> Democratic Party lawmakers cite the government's real estate policy as the decisive cause of the decline in approval ratings for both the president and the party. Indeed, in the National Indicator Survey released that day, positive evaluations of the current government's real estate policy stood at 34%, while negative evaluations were 56%. Regarding the president's overall state affairs management, 49% said he was doing well, marking the lowest figure since President Lee's inauguration according to this survey. By region, Daegu and North Gyeongsang, a conservative stronghold, recorded the lowest at 36%, followed by Seoul at 42%, where real estate sensitivity is high, and Incheon and Gyeonggi at 49% (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). In response, Cheong Wa Dae Senior Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung said, "We are carefully reviewing whether there are any shortcomings, and we are well aware of the concerns about real estate," adding, "We will respond with results." (13일 열린 더불어민주당 의원총회에서 수도권 의원들을 중심으로 정부의 부동산 세제 개편안에 대한 비판이 강하게 제기됐다. 특히 “대통령이 세금으로 집값 잡지 않겠다고 여러 번 말했는데 신뢰가 깨졌다” “이대로 가면 총선이든 대선이든 폭망한다” 등의 발언도 나왔다. 2028년 총선을 앞두고 부동산 민심이 선거에 미칠 부정적 영향에 대한 우려가 쏟아진 것이다. 민주당 지도부는 이날 의원총회 이후 “정부안 자체를 완전히 반대한다는 것은 아니다”면서도 정부의 세제안과 주택 공급안에 대한 수정·보완 가능성을 언급했다.)

item.title: Lee Targets Oh Se-hoon over 'Greenbelt Release and Yongsan Development Disagreement' — "Even If It Means Revising Laws and Systems, Provide Land Parcels Drastically" (‘그린벨트 해제·용산 개발 이견’ 오세훈 겨냥 李 “법과 제도 고쳐서라도 택지 파격 공급”)
item.description:
Lee Targets Oh Se-hoon over 'Greenbelt Release and Yongsan Development Disagreement' — "Even If It Means Revising Laws and Systems, Provide Land Parcels Drastically" (‘그린벨트 해제·용산 개발 이견’ 오세훈 겨냥 李 “법과 제도 고쳐서라도 택지 파격 공급”)

President Lee Jae-myung said at the presidential senior secretary meeting on the 13th, "The real estate bubble can no longer be left unattended," adding, "We must concentrate all available means and capabilities on resolving the housing problem, which is like a time bomb." The President stated, "Supply policy in particular has become a problem," and "Given the many realistic constraints and the lengthy time required, we must launch an all-out supply offensive with extraordinary resolve." (이재명 대통령은 13일 청와대 수석보좌관 회의에서 “부동산 거품도 더는 방치할 수 없는 수준”이라며 “시한폭탄 같은 부동산 문제 해결에 가용한 수단과 역량을 집중 투입해야 한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이날 “공급 정책이 특히 문제가 되고 있다”며 “공급 정책의 경우 현실적인 제약 요소도 많고, 또 소요 기간도 길어서 더욱 특별한 각오를 가지고 전방위적인 공급 총력전에 나서야 된다”고 했다.)

The President said, "As the public is aware, there has been a supply cliff since 2022," adding, "Permits have been drastically reduced and construction starts have also declined significantly, so a supply cliff has inevitably occurred, and extraordinary efforts are needed to fill that gap." This implies that the previous administration failed to adequately supply housing in a timely manner, leading to the current shortage. The ruling party has consistently argued that "the incompetence of the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, the Oh Se-hoon city government, and the People Power Party, which was the ruling party at the time, are the main culprits behind the current supply cliff." (이 대통령은 “국민 여러분이 아시는 것처럼 2022년 그때부터 지금까지 공급 절벽”이라며 “인·허가도 매우 축소됐고 착공도 매우 많이 줄어들어서 불가피하게 일종의 공급 절벽이 발생했기 때문에 이를 메우기 위한 특단의 노력이 필요하다”고 했다. 전임 정부가 제때 부동산 공급을 제대로 하지 않아 현재 공급이 부족하다는 것이다. 여권은 그동안 부동산 문제에 대해 “윤석열 정부와 오세훈 시정, 당시 여당이던 국민의힘의 무능함이 현재 공급 절벽을 초래한 주범”이라고 해왔다.)

Furthermore, the President said, "We must shorten various permitting procedures as much as possible, and for land parcels, we should not be bound by existing regulations—even if it means revising laws and systems, we must secure them boldly and proceed with supply." This is interpreted as a remark aimed at Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, who has differed with the government over issues such as greenbelt release and the scale of housing supply in the Yongsan International Business District. The government intends to push through its plans even if it means revising the current Enforcement Decree of the Development Restriction Areas Act, which delegates authority to release greenbelts smaller than 300,000㎡ in the metropolitan area to provincial and city governors. (그러면서 이 대통령은 “각종 인허가 절차를 최대한 단축하고 또 택지도 기존 규제에 얽매이지 말고 필요하면 법과 제도를 고쳐서라도 파격적으로 확보해서 공급에 나서야 되겠다”고 했다. 이는 그린벨트 해제, 용산국제업무지구 내 주택 공급 규모 등을 두고 정부와 이견을 보여 온 오세훈 서울시장을 겨냥한 발언으로 풀이된다. 수도권 30만㎡ 미만 그린벨트 해제 권한을 시·도지사에게 위임한 현행 개발제한구역법 시행령을 고쳐서라도 정부의 구상을 관철하겠다는 것이다.)

In response, Mayor Oh expressed "deep regret" via a Facebook post, saying there was no sufficient prior consultation with the Seoul Metropolitan Government before the government announced its supply measures. He also noted that the measures "did not reflect key demands from the field, such as easing restrictions on the transfer of union member status, relaxing floor area ratio regulations for private redevelopment projects, and lowering the mandatory ratio of rental housing in redevelopment projects," adding, "For housing supply to accelerate, deregulation must not remain a mere gesture." The Seoul Metropolitan Government believes that if currently ongoing redevelopment projects proceed normally through deregulation, construction on up to 310,000 housing units across 253 zones could begin by 2031. Regarding the greenbelt release, Mayor Oh stated his opposition, saying, "Damaging green space should be the last resort." (이에 대해 오 시장은 페이스북 글을 통해 정부의 공급 대책 발표 전 서울시와 충분한 사전 협의가 없었다며 “깊은 유감”이라고 했다. 또 이번 대책에 “조합원 지위 양도 제한 완화, 민간 정비 사업 용적률 규제 완화, 재개발 임대주택 비율 완화 등 현장에서 요구하는 핵심 사항은 반영되지 않았다”며 “주택 공급이 속도를 내기 위해서는 규제 완화가 시늉에 머물러서는 안 된다”고 했다. 서울시는 규제 완화 등을 통해 현재 추진 중인 정비 사업이 정상적으로 진행되면 2031년까지 253개 구역에서 최대 31만 호 착공이 가능할 것으로 보고 있다. 그린벨트 해제에 대해 오 시장은 “녹지 훼손은 최후의 수단”이라며 반대 입장을 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, the President also said, "If we change policies after announcing them, they are criticized as inconsistent and flip-flopping, so we tend to avoid changes—but that is an outdated way of thinking." He added, "Public officials and civil servants cannot be 100 percent perfect," and that listening to opinions and revising announced policies to create better ones is "a normal policy decision process." This appears to be aimed at the opposition party, which has criticized the government's policy revisions as "patchwork." (한편 이 대통령은 “정책을 발표한 뒤 바꾸면 일관성이 없고 오락가락 이런 식으로 평가되는 것 때문에 잘 안 바꾸려고 하지만, 그것은 낡은 과거 방식”이라고도 했다. 또 “공직자, 공무원이 100% 완벽한 존재일 수 없다”며, 발표한 정책도 의견을 듣고 수정해 더 나은 정책을 만들어가는 것이 “정상적인 정책 결정 과정”이라고 했다. 정부의 정책 수정을 “누더기”라고 비판하는 야당을 겨냥한 것으로 보인다.)

The People Power Party said in a commentary, "The supply in central Seoul that the market truly desires most amounts to only 1,000 units at the Yeomchang Park site in Gangseo-gu," and "With these ineffective and hollow policies, they are following in the footsteps of the Moon Jae-in administration's failures." It also accused the government of "insisting that its floundering real estate policies are 'normal.'" (국민의힘은 논평을 통해 “정작 시장이 가장 간절히 원하는 서울 도심 공급은 강서구 염창공원 부지 1000호가 전부”라며 “실효성 없는 맹탕 정책으로 문재인 정부의 실패 궤적을 밟고 있다”고 했다. 또 “좌충우돌 부동산 정책을 ‘정상’이라 우긴다”고도 했다.)

item.title: Financial Services Commission and Financial Supervisory Service Headed to Sejong... State-Run Banks Like Industrial Bank, IBK, and Export-Import Bank Also Moving to Regions (금융위·금감원, 세종행 가닥… 산업·기업·수출입 은행도 지방으로)
item.description:
Financial Services Commission and Financial Supervisory Service Headed to Sejong... State-Run Banks Like Industrial Bank, IBK, and Export-Import Bank Also Moving to Regions (금융위·금감원, 세종행 가닥… 산업·기업·수출입 은행도 지방으로)

The government has prepared a plan to relocate the Financial Services Commission, the Financial Supervisory Service, and the Personal Information Protection Commission, currently based in Seoul, to Sejong, and is awaiting the president's final approval, it was reported on the 13th. Plans to move state-run banks such as the Industrial Bank of Korea, the Industrial Bank of Korea (IBK), and the Export-Import Bank of Korea to regional areas are also under review. (정부가 현재 서울에 있는 금융위원회와 금융감독원, 개인정보보호위원회를 세종으로 이전하는 방안을 마련하고, 대통령의 최종 승인을 앞두고 있는 것으로 13일 알려졌다. 산업은행과 기업은행, 수출입은행 등 국책은행을 지방으로 옮기는 방안도 검토하고 있다.)

According to related ministries on the 13th, the government plans to announce the relocation of central government agencies and the second-phase plan for moving public institutions to regional areas as early as the end of this month. The Financial Services Commission and the Personal Information Protection Commission, currently housed in the Government Seoul Complex, and the Financial Supervisory Service in Yeouido, have been included in the list for relocation to Sejong. The exact timing of the move and detailed plans such as office buildings are said to be in the coordination stage. The relocation will be confirmed once the Minister of the Interior and Safety establishes the plan and the president approves it. (13일 관계 부처에 따르면 정부는 이르면 이달 말 중앙 부처 이전과 2차 공공기관 지방 이전 계획을 발표할 계획이다. 현재 정부서울청사에 있는 금융위와 개보위, 여의도에 있는 금융감독원은 세종 이전 대상에 포함됐다. 이전 시점과 청사 등 세부 계획은 조율 단계라고 알려졌다. 이전은 행정안전부 장관이 계획을 수립하고 대통령이 승인하면 확정된다.)

If the relocation plan for the Financial Services Commission and the Financial Supervisory Service is finalized, the financial regulatory, supervisory, and enforcement functions will leave Seoul for Sejong, following the economic policy establishment and coordination functions of the Ministry of Economy and Finance, which are already located at the Government Sejong Complex. This would leave only administrative functions such as diplomacy and national defense in Seoul. (금융위, 금감원 등의 지방 이전안이 확정되면 이미 정부세종청사에 있는 재정경제부의 경제 정책 수립·총괄 기능에 이어 금융 규제·감독과 집행 기능도 서울을 벗어나 세종으로 가게 된다. 서울에는 행정 기능 가운데 외교·국방 등만 남게 되는 셈이다.)

Financial authorities such as the Financial Services Commission and the Financial Supervisory Service, along with state-run banks like the Industrial Bank of Korea and the Export-Import Bank of Korea, have opposed the regional relocation. Their reasoning is that they need to communicate frequently on work matters with financial companies headquartered in Seoul, such as banks, insurance firms, and securities companies, and that relocating to regional areas would make it difficult to secure professional talent. (금융위, 금감원 등 금융 당국과 산업은행, 수출입은행 등 국책 은행들은 지방 이전에 반대해왔다. 서울에 본사를 둔 은행, 보험사, 증권사 등 금융 회사들과 수시로 업무 관련 소통을 해야 하고, 지방 이전 시 전문 인력 확보가 어려워진다는 이유다.)

A source in the financial sector said, "During the last presidential election, President Lee promised to connect the Yeouido financial hub with the Yongsan International Business District to make Seoul a financial business hub, but the policy is heading in the opposite direction." They added, "If the government is applying the logic it used to move the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries to Busan, where shipping and port companies are concentrated, then financial work belongs in Seoul." However, an official from an economic ministry said, "If the Financial Services Commission moves, coordination with economic ministries in Sejong will become smoother." (금융권 관계자는 “지난 대선 때 이 대통령이 여의도 금융 허브와 용산 국제업무지구를 연결해 서울을 금융 비즈니스 거점으로 만들겠다고 공약했는데 정책은 반대로 가는 상황”이라고 했다. “정부가 해양수산부를 해운·항만 기업이 모여 있는 부산으로 옮긴 논리라면, 금융 업무는 서울에 있는 게 맞는다”는 것이다. 다만 경제 부처 관계자는 “금융위가 이전하면 세종에 있는 경제 부처와의 업무 조율이 원활해질 것”이라고 했다.)

Relocating the state-run banks will also require legislative amendments. The laws establishing the Industrial Bank of Korea and the IBK stipulate that their headquarters must be located in Seoul. The Yoon Suk-yeol administration attempted to move the Industrial Bank of Korea to Busan in line with its presidential campaign pledge, but the plan fell through when the Democratic Party of Korea, then the opposition, refused to agree to amend the Industrial Bank of Korea Act. Union opposition is also a variable. The National Financial Industry Labor Union plans to launch a general strike starting on the 4th of next month to block the regional relocation of financial institutions and push for a 4.5-day workweek. (국책은행을 이전하기 위해서는 법도 개정해야 한다. 산업은행과 기업은행은 설립 근거법에 본점을 서울에 두도록 규정돼 있다. 윤석열 정부는 대선 공약에 따라 산업은행을 부산으로 이전하려 했지만 당시 야당이었던 더불어민주당이 산업은행법 개정에 동의하지 않으면서 이전이 무산됐다. 노조의 반발도 변수다. 전국금융산업노동조합은 다음 달 4일부터 금융기관 지방 이전 저지와 주 4.5일제 도입 등을 위한 총파업에 돌입할 계획이다.)

Although the government has not yet made its announcement, competition among local governments to attract public institutions is already fierce. Busan, Daegu, South Gyeongsang, and North Jeolla are competing over the IBK, while South Jeolla-Gwangju, North Jeolla, and North Gyeongsang are vying for the National Agricultural Cooperative Federation (Nonghyup). Local governments are also rapidly forming committees such as "All-Citizen Public Institution Attraction Committees." (정부 발표가 나오기 전이지만 공공기관을 유치하려는 지방자치단체들의 경쟁은 이미 치열하다. 기업은행 한 곳을 놓고 부산·대구·경남·전북이, 농협중앙회를 놓고는 전남광주·전북·경북이 경쟁하고 있다. 지자체별로 ‘범시민 공공기관 유치위원회’ 등도 우후죽순 생기고 있다.)

A government official said, "Whichever way it is decided, there will inevitably be backlash; it's a politically sensitive issue." For this reason, there is a sentiment within the ruling party that the regional relocation of public institutions should be expedited to prevent it from becoming a political flashpoint in the 2028 general election. There is also a perceived need to appease regions that did not benefit from the government's mega projects, such as the Honam semiconductor cluster. (정부 관계자는 “어디로 결정되든 후폭풍이 생길 수밖에 없다”며 “정치적으로 예민한 문제”라고 했다. 이 때문에 여권 내에선 공공기관 지방 이전을 서둘러 2028년 총선 때 정치 쟁점화되지 않도록 해야 한다는 기류가 있다. 또 호남 반도체 클러스터 등 정부의 메가 프로젝트에서 수혜를 받지 못하는 지역들의 반발을 무마해야 해야 한다는 필요성도 제기된다.)

The relocation of public institutions to regional areas began under the Roh Moo-hyun administration, and through the Moon Jae-in administration, a total of around 150 institutions were moved to regional areas. Additional relocations were reviewed during the Yoon Suk-yeol administration but were not implemented due to controversies over their effectiveness. President Lee Jae-myung has emphasized a balanced regional development stance since taking office. At a Cabinet meeting held in Sejong on the 11th, President Lee said, "Please make every effort to usher in the era of the president's Sejong office within our administration's term and hold the final Cabinet meeting of the term in the Sejong office." (공공기관 지방 이전은 노무현 정부 때 시작해 문재인 정부까지 총 150여 기관이 지방으로 이전했다. 윤석열 정부에서도 추가 이전이 검토됐지만 이전 효과 등을 둘러싼 논란 등으로 실행되지 않았다. 이재명 대통령은 취임 후 지방 균형 발전 기조를 강조했다. 이 대통령은 지난 11일 세종에서 국무회의를 열고 “우리 정부 임기 내에 대통령 세종 집무실 시대를 열고, 임기 마지막 국무회의도 세종 집무실에서 개최한다는 자세로 총력을 다해달라”고 했다.)

item.title: North Korea Drone Incursion Alert Military Communication System Down for 3 Hours (北 무인기 침투 알리는 軍 전파체계, 3시간 동안 ‘먹통’)
item.description:
North Korea Drone Incursion Alert Military Communication System Down for 3 Hours (北 무인기 침투 알리는 軍 전파체계, 3시간 동안 ‘먹통’)

The military's "high-speed situation dissemination system," a core system used by field units to report situations such as North Korean drone or boat infiltrations to the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS), experienced an outage for approximately three hours on the night of the 12th. This affected the entire South Korean military. (북한의 무인기나 목선이 침투한 경우 현장 부대에서 합동참모본부 등으로 상황을 전파하는 핵심 시스템인 군의 ‘고속 상황 전파 체계’ 작동이 12일 밤 3시간가량 중단된 것으로 알려졌다. 이로 인해 우리 군 전체가 영향을 받았다.)

According to a compilation of this newspaper's reporting on the 13th, the military's high-speed situation dissemination system was down for a little over three hours the previous night. This system operates on the "Defense Network," a military-only intranet not connected to the external internet, and it is understood that there was a problem with the Defense Network server. The high-speed situation dissemination system was only restored in the early hours of the 13th. (13일 본지 취재를 종합하면 전날 밤 약 3시간 남짓 우리 군의 고속 상황 전파 체계가 먹통이 됐다. 이 시스템은 외부 인터넷과 연결되지 않은 군 전용 정보통신망인 ‘국방망’을 기반으로 작동하는데, 국방망 서버에 문제가 있었던 것으로 전해졌다. 고속 상황 전파 체계는 13일 새벽에야 복구됐다.)

The high-speed situation dissemination system can simultaneously transmit situations from frontline Guard Posts (GPs) or General Outposts (GOPs) to the JCS and all Army, Navy, and Air Force units. Among the military's various information dissemination systems, it enables the fastest bottom-up reporting and top-down orders. For this reason, matters included in the JCS's "emergency situation reporting list," including drone intrusions, are required to be reported through this system. (고속 상황 전파 체계는 최전방의 감시초소(GP)나 일반전초(GOP)부터 합동참모본부까지 육·해·공군 전 부대에 동시에 상황을 전달할 수 있는 시스템이다. 군의 여러 정보 전파 체계 중 상향식(바텀 업) 보고와 하향식(탑 다운) 지시 모두를 가장 신속하게 할 수 있다. 이 때문에 무인기 침투를 비롯해 합참의 ‘긴급 상황 보고 목록’에 포함된 사안은 이 체계를 통해 보고하게 돼 있다.)

Regarding this critical system being inoperative for about three hours, the JCS told this newspaper, "There was a temporary malfunction in the high-speed situation dissemination system, but we maintained normal readiness by utilizing other means and systems." The implication is that it could be supplemented through wired telephones, video conferencing systems, and the Army Tactical Command Information System (ATCIS). (이런 중요 체계가 3시간가량 작동하지 않은 데 대해 합참은 본지에 “고속 상황 전파 체계의 일시적인 장애가 발생했지만, 다른 수단 및 체계를 활용하여 정상적인 대비태세를 유지했다”고 밝혔다. 유선전화, 화상회의 시스템, 육군 전술 지휘 정보 체계(ATCIS) 등을 통해 보완이 가능했다는 취지다.)

However, wired telephones and video conferencing systems cannot deliver information instantly from frontline outposts to the JCS, and ATCIS, an Army system, is also known to be unable to transmit information directly to the JCS. Yang Wook, a research fellow at the Asan Institute for Policy Studies, said, "Three hours is enough time for North Korea to inflict serious damage on the Korean Peninsula with missile and suicide drone attacks. This was a clear security vacuum, but the military authorities are complacently responding as if 'there was no major problem.'" (하지만 유선전화와 화상회의 시스템은 말단 소초에서 합참까지 즉각적 정보 전달이 불가능하고, 육군 시스템인 ATCIS도 합참으로 직접 정보 전달은 불가능한 것으로 알려졌다. 양욱 아산정책연구원 연구위원은 “3시간은 북한이 미사일과 자폭 드론 공격으로 한반도에 심각한 타격을 줄 수 있는 시간”이라며 “명백한 안보 공백이 발생했는데, 군 당국이 ‘큰 문제는 없었다’며 안일하게 대처하고 있다”고 했다.)

The fact that the military's core communication network had been paralyzed was first reported online on the 12th. This meant there was a possibility that hostile nations such as North Korea could exploit it. A military source said, "In the past, there would have been hesitation within the military about leaking the situation externally due to concerns about security investigations by the Defense Counterintelligence Command, but amid the dismantlement of the command, the erosion of military discipline has reached a serious level." (군의 핵심 통신망이 마비됐다는 사실은 12일 온라인에서 먼저 알려졌다. 북한 등 적국이 이를 악용할 가능성도 있었던 것이다. 군 소식통은 “과거라면 방첩사령부 보안조사 등을 우려해 군 내부에서 상황을 외부로 유출하는 데 부담을 느꼈을 텐데, 방첩사 해체와 맞물려 군 기강 해이가 심각한 수준”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee "Introducing Selective Volunteer System"... Blue House "Plan Announcement Within Year, Implementation Next Year" (李 “선택적 모병제 도입”… 靑 “연내 계획 발표, 내년 시행”)
item.description:
Lee "Introducing Selective Volunteer System"... Blue House "Plan Announcement Within Year, Implementation Next Year" (李 “선택적 모병제 도입”… 靑 “연내 계획 발표, 내년 시행”)

The Blue House announced on the 13th that it plans to implement a "selective volunteer system" — recruiting some troops on a volunteer basis — starting next year. This selective volunteer system maintains the framework of conscription but converts specialized military branches handling cutting-edge technology to a volunteer system. It was a campaign pledge by President Lee Jae-myung, but this is the first time a specific implementation timeline has been disclosed. Amid a recent decline in President Lee's approval ratings, this policy is being interpreted as a move mindful of the sentiments of the 2030 youth demographic, where his support is relatively weaker. However, some point out that since non-commissioned officers in technology-intensive fields requiring high skill are already selected through volunteer recruitment, it is unclear how much practical difference the "selective volunteer system" will make compared to the current setup. (청와대가 일부 병력을 모병제로 모집하는 ‘선택적 모병제’를 내년부터 시행할 예정이라고 13일 밝혔다. 징병제의 틀을 유지하되 최첨단 기술을 다루는 전문 병과는 모병제로 전환하는 선택적 모병제는 이재명 대통령의 대선 공약이었지만, 구체적 시행 시점이 공개된 것은 이번이 처음이다. 최근 이 대통령의 지지율이 하락세를 보이는 가운데, 상대적으로 지지세가 약한 2030 청년층의 민심을 의식한 정책이라는 해석이 나온다. 다만 현재도 숙련도가 요구되는 기술집약적 분야의 부사관은 모병 방식으로 선발하고 있는 만큼, ‘선택적 모병제’가 기존과 얼마나 실질적인 차이를 만들어낼지는 불분명하다는 지적도 나온다.)

President Lee chaired a senior secretaries' meeting at the Blue House that day and said, "Due to the持续 low birth rate, maintaining the current manpower-intensive, infantry-centered inefficient military structure is neither possible nor desirable." He added, "We must swiftly and thoroughly push forward defense reform to transform our military into a smart, elite, and powerful force centered on cutting-edge equipment and technology by introducing the selective volunteer system." He further stated that "redesigning the system so that our youth, the main actors of national defense, can plan better lives in the future" is important. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 수석보좌관회의를 주재하며 “지속적인 저출생 때문에 현재 같은 인력 중심인 보병 중심의 비효율적인 군 구조를 유지하는 것은 가능하지도 않고, 바람직하지도 않다”며 “선택적 모병제를 도입해 우리 군을 첨단 장비와 기술 중심의 스마트 정예 강군으로 탈바꿈시키려는 국방 개혁을 빠르고 빈틈없이 추진해야 한다”고 말했다. 이어 “국방의 주역인 우리 청년들이 미래에 더 나은 삶을 계획할 수 있도록 제도를 재설계하는 것”이 중요하다고 했다.)

The Blue House's first disclosure of the "implementation next year" plan came after a subsequent closed-door meeting. Senior Press Secretary Kang Yu-jung said, "As for the specific plans for the (selective volunteer system), the Ministry of National Defense is expected to announce them within the year," and "We plan to implement the system starting next year, taking initial operational outcomes into account for subsequent revisions and improvements." (청와대가 처음으로 ‘내년 시행’ 방침을 밝힌 것은 그에 이어진 비공개 회의 후였다. 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 “(선택적 모병제의) 구체적인 계획에 대해서는 국방부가 연내에 발표할 것으로 보인다”며 “내년부터 제도를 시행하면서 초기 운영 성과를 고려해 이후 수정 및 보완하는 것으로 추진할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Press Secretary Kang reported that during the closed-door meeting, President Lee instructed, "Life is an investment. Time in the military must not be in vain," and "Reflect the values and current realities of young people's lives and come up with diverse and creative ideas that go beyond existing perspectives." He noted that President Lee made remarks suggesting that easing the burden of military service is part of youth policy, and that "a roadmap, including implementation next year, was roughly discussed at today's meeting." (강 대변인은 비공개 회의에서 이 대통령이 “인생은 투자다. 군에서의 시간이 헛되지 않아야 한다”며 “청년들의 가치관과 삶의 현주소를 반영해 기존 시선에 국한되지 않는 다양하고 창의적인 아이디어를 마련해 달라”고 지시했다고 전했다. 이 대통령이 군 복무 부담을 덜어주는 게 청년 정책의 일환이라는 취지의 발언을 했고, 내년 시행을 포함한 “로드맵이 오늘 대략 회의에서 논의되었다”는 것이다.)

In 2021, ahead of the 20th presidential election, President Lee first pledged the selective volunteer system, saying, "We will reduce the size of conscripted troops to 150,000 within my term." At the time, he described the system as one that "maintains universal conscription while allowing those subject to military service to choose between being a 'conscript' and 'technology-intensive combat non-commissioned officer volunteer service,'" and said, "In fields requiring military expertise, we will deploy technology-intensive combat non-commissioned officers and military civilian personnel instead of conscripts." (이 대통령은 20대 대선을 앞둔 2021년에 처음 “임기 내에 징집병의 규모를 15만명으로 축소하겠다”며 선택적 모병제를 공약했다. 당시 이 대통령은 이 제도가 “국민개병제를 유지하면서 병역 대상자가 ‘징집병’과 ‘기술집약형 전투부사관 모병’ 가운데 선택할 수 있는 제도”라며 “군의 전문성이 요구되는 분야에는 징집병 대신 기술집약형 전투부사관과 군무원을 배치하겠다”고 했었다.)

During last year's presidential election, President Lee maintained the framework of this pledge, and since taking office, he has repeatedly mentioned pursuing the selective volunteer system. In June, during a visit to the Marine Corps Yeonpyeong Unit on Yeonpyeong Island in Ongjin County, Incheon, President Lee said at a luncheon discussion with troops, "As I have promised several times, we will minimize conscripts and change the system so that through volunteer recruitment, people can choose the military as their own career," adding, "What we are pursuing is a selective volunteer system, where one can choose to become a professional soldier receiving adequate pay within budget constraints, or if they don't want that, serve through short-term conscription." (지난해 대선 때도 이 대통령은 이 공약의 틀을 유지했고, 취임 이후 선택적 모병제 추진을 여러 차례 언급했다. 지난 6월 인천 옹진군 연평도의 해병대 연평부대를 방문한 이 대통령은 장병들과의 오찬 간담회에서 “여러 차례 약속했듯 징집병들을 최소화하고, 모병을 통해서 자기 자신의 직장으로 군을 선택할 수 있게 바꿔 나가겠다”며 “우리가 하려는 것은 선택적 모병제로, 예산의 허용 범위 내에서 충분한 보수를 지급받는 직업군인을 선택하든지 혹은 그게 싫으면 단기 징병에 응하는 것”이라고 했다.)

In this regard, the Ministry of National Defense is known to plan to include specific measures for the selective volunteer system in its basic defense reform plan, expected to be announced around this autumn. Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek said at a press briefing in April regarding the selective volunteer system, "We will have about 50,000 technology-intensive non-commissioned officers handling cutting-edge weapons, and establish a system that connects to careers after discharge." The goal is for these non-commissioned officers to remain in the military for at least 4-5 years to operate cutting-edge weapons. (이와 관련, 국방부는 올 가을쯤 발표 예정인 국방개혁 기본계획에 선택적 모병제의 구체적 방안을 담을 예정인 것으로 알려졌다. 안규백 국방부 장관은 지난 4월 기자간담회에서 선택적 모병제와 관련해 “최첨단 무기를 다루는 기술집약형 부사관 5만명 정도를 두고, 전역 후에도 직업과 연계할 수 있는 시스템을 갖출 것”이라고 했다. 이 부사관들이 최소 4~5년간 군에 있으면서 최첨단 무기를 다룰 수 있도록 한다는 것이다.)

In response to a query from this newspaper in June about the progress of the selective volunteer system, the Ministry of National Defense said, "We are refining the plan, and in connection with this, we are pushing to begin selecting technology-intensive non-commissioned officers as early as next year," and "We are consulting with each branch of the military on manpower requirements." However, it is reported that some within the military have expressed concerns that "not much preparation has been done." There is speculation that with youth approval ratings falling sharply recently, the Blue House may be rushing the selective volunteer system. (국방부 측은 지난 6월 선택적 모병제 추진 현황을 묻는 본지 질의에 “방안을 구체화해 나가고 있고, 이와 연계해 기술집약형 부사관은 이르면 내년부터 선발할 수 있도록 추진 중”이라며 “각 군과 인력 소요 등을 협의하고 있다”고 했다. 다만 군 내 일각에서는 “준비를 별로 하지 못한 상황”이라는 우려도 나오는 것으로 전해졌다. 최근 청년층 지지율이 가파르게 하락하자, 청와대가 선택적 모병을 서두르려는 것 아니냐는 얘기다.)

Meanwhile, at the meeting that day, President Lee also called for improving the treatment of junior military officers. He said, "Please move quickly and decisively to improve the treatment of junior officers," adding, "Ultimately, defense is carried out by people. A truly strong military is built when young people find military service rewarding and the military robustly supports their transition into society." He then urged relevant ministries to "make every effort to identify and promptly implement necessary financial and institutional support policies." (한편 이 대통령은 이날 회의에서 군 초급 간부 처우 개선도 주문했다. 이 대통령은 “초급 간부들에 대한 처우 개선 역시 빠르고 과감하게 추진해 주기 바란다”며 “결국 국방도 사람이 하는 것이다. 청년들이 군 복무를 보람 있게 생각하고, 군이 청년들의 사회 진출을 든든하게 뒷받침해 줄 때 진짜 강한 군대가 만들어진다”고 했다. 그러면서 관계 부처에 “필요한 재정적, 제도적 지원 정책을 최선을 다해 발굴하고 조속히 시행해 달라”고 당부했다.)

item.title: Although a Cheonanham victim's family member... Yoon Cheong-ja grandmother excluded from Blue House veterans' family event (천안함 유족이지만… 靑 보훈가족 행사에 윤청자 할머니 제외)
item.description:
Although a Cheonanham victim's family member... Yoon Cheong-ja grandmother excluded from Blue House veterans' family event (천안함 유족이지만… 靑 보훈가족 행사에 윤청자 할머니 제외)

President Lee Jae-myung invited national merit holders and veterans' families to the Blue House Yeongbingwan on the 13th for a luncheon and stated, "When it comes to repaying the noble sacrifice of those who risked their lives for the fatherland, is there any distinction between progressives and conservatives?" adding, "I will do my utmost so that the Republic of Korea, built on the sacrifice and dedication of national merit holders and veterans' families, can leap forward further as a more shining Republic of Korea on the world stage." (이재명 대통령이 13일 국가 유공자와 보훈 가족을 청와대 영빈관에 초청해 오찬을 갖고 “조국을 위해 목숨을 건 숭고한 헌신에 보답하는 일에 진보, 보수가 따로 있겠냐”며 “국가 유공자와 보훈 가족의 희생과 헌신으로 이룩한 대한민국이 세계 속에 더 빛나는 대한민국으로 더 크게 도약할 수 있도록 있는 힘을 다하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee said this at the event, adding, "If someone had not defended this country, there would be no Republic of Korea today, nor our everyday lives," and "By rewarding special sacrifices with special compensation, and by remembering and recording them, we must surely build a nation where, in times of crisis, someone will step forward for all of us." (이 대통령은 이 자리에서 이같이 말하며 “누군가가 이 나라를 지켜내지 않았다면 오늘의 대한민국, 또 우리의 일상적인 삶은 없다”며 “특별한 희생에 특별한 보상으로 그들의 긍지를 채워드리고, 기억하고, 기록함으로써 우리가 위기에 처했을 때 누군가 우리 모두를 위해서 선두에 나설 수 있는 그런 나라를 꼭 만들어야 한다”고 했다.)

The event on this day was attended by about 180 people, including members of veterans' organizations such as national merit holders and their bereaved families, descendants of independence activists residing abroad, bereaved families of soldiers and firefighters who died in the line of duty, bereaved families of those who died defending the West Sea, and war veterans. However, Yoon Cheong-ja, the mother of the late Master Sergeant Min Pyeong-gi, who died in the sinking of the Cheonan, was not invited. Yoon had approached President Lee at the 11th West Sea Defense Day ceremony in March and asked him to "make efforts to receive an apology from North Korea," but President Lee's response—"Do you think they'd apologize just because we ask?"—had sparked controversy. (이날 행사에는 국가 유공자와 유가족 등 보훈 단체 회원을 비롯해 재외 독립 유공자 후손, 순직 군인·소방공무원 유가족, 서해 수호 전사자 유가족과 참전 장병 등 180여 명이 함께했다. 다만 천안함 폭침으로 순직한 고 민평기 상사 어머니 윤청자 씨는 초청하지 않았다. 윤 씨는 지난 3월 제11회 서해 수호의 날 기념식에서 이 대통령에게 다가가 “북한에게 사과를 받도록 노력해 달라”고 말했으나, 이 대통령이 “사과를 하라고 한다고 하겠냐”고 답해 논란이 불거진 바 있다.)

In a phone call, the bereaved family of Master Sergeant Min stated, "We have received no contact from the Blue House," and added, "The Cheonan itself is an uncomfortable topic for this administration." A Blue House official said, "The participating invitees were determined by each organization," and "We mainly invited people who have not attended Blue House events over the past five years." On this day, regarding the Cheonan incident, three people attended: former Captain Choi Won-il, a bereaved family member, and an injured sailor. (민 상사 유족은 통화에서 “청와대로부터 연락을 받은 바 없다”며 “천안함 자체가 이 정부에게는 불편한 소재”라고 했다. 청와대 관계자는 “참석 대상은 각 단체가 정했다”며 “최근 5 년간 청와대 행사에 참석하지 않은 사람을 위주로 모셨다”고 했다. 이날 천안함 사건 관련해서는 최원일 전 함장과 유족, 부상 장병 등 3명이 참석했다.)

Among the specially invited guests this day were descendants of independence activists residing abroad, including Chopov Sergey and Chopov Maxim, great-grandsons through the maternal line of the late Mr. Heo Wi, who devoted himself to the independence movement; Kim Maksim, a great-grandson through the maternal line of the late Mr. Min Geung-ho; and Kim Alina, a great-great-granddaughter of the late Mr. Kim Gyeong-cheon. Blue House Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryeong said, "President Lee personally pinned Taegeukgi badges on representatives from each field of independence, national defense, and democracy," adding, "The names of the attendees were engraved on the back of the badges, conveying respect and gratitude for their sacrifice and dedication to the nation and community." (이날 특별 초청 대상자로는 독립운동에 헌신한 고 허위 선생의 외고손인 초포프 세르게이와 초포프 막심, 고 민긍호 선생의 외고손자 김막심 씨, 고 김경천 선생의 고손녀 김알리나 씨 등 재외 독립 유공자 후손들이 참석했다. 안귀령 청와대 부대변인은 “이 대통령은 독립·호국·민주 분야별 대표에게 태극기 배지를 직접 달아줬다”며 “배지 뒷면에는 참석자들의 이름을 새겨 국가와 공동체를 위한 희생과 헌신에 대한 존경과 감사의 마음을 담았다”고 전했다.)

item.title: 'Baekbeom's Wife' Choi Jun-rye, Anti-Japanese Actress Kim Deok-rin... Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Honors 283 Independence Fighters (‘백범 부인’ 최준례·항일배우 김덕린… 보훈부, 독립유공자 283명 포상)
item.description:
'Baekbeom's Wife' Choi Jun-rye, Anti-Japanese Actress Kim Deok-rin... Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Honors 283 Independence Fighters (‘백범 부인’ 최준례·항일배우 김덕린… 보훈부, 독립유공자 283명 포상)

The Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs announced on the 13th that, ahead of this year's 81st Liberation Day, it will award a total of 283 people as independence fighters, including conferring the Order of Merit for National Foundation (Aejojang) upon Choi Jun-rye (1889–1924), wife of Baekbeom Kim Gu who supported the activities of the Provisional Government of the Republic of Korea, and Kim Deok-rin (1919–1983, stage name Kim Yeom), who worked as an anti-Japanese film actress in China. (국가보훈부가 올해 제81주년 광복절을 맞아 백범 김구 선생의 부인으로 대한민국 임시정부 활동을 지원한 최준례(1889∼1924) 여사와 중국에서 항일 영화배우로 활동한 김덕린(1919∼1983·예명 김염) 선생에게 건국훈장 애족장을 서훈하는 등 총 283명을 독립유공자로 포상한다고 13일 밝혔다.)

Choi supported her husband Kim Gu during his four years in prison after the Japanese Government-General of Korea arrested him in 1911, and took the lead in women's enlightenment activities as a teacher at a girls' school. Even after going into exile in Shanghai in 1920, she continued to support Kim Gu's activities. Kim Deok-rin is recognized for starring in several films in the 1930s that inspired anti-Japanese consciousness, instilling courage in both Korean and Chinese people. The Order of Merit for National Foundation (Aegukjang) will also be posthumously conferred upon Kim Yeong-ho, Kim Se-cheol, and Nam Gi-seok, who died while leading a Manse (independence) protest as miners at the Jiksan mine in Chungnam during the Japanese occupation. (최 여사는 1911년 일제 조선총독부가 김구 선생을 체포하자 4년간 옥바라지하고, 여학교 교사로 여성 계몽 활동에 앞장섰다. 1920년 상하이 망명 이후에도 김구 선생의 활동을 지원했다. 김덕린 선생은 1930년대 항일의식을 고취하는 여러 영화에 주연으로 출연해 한국과 중국 국민에게 용기를 심어줬다는 평가를 받는다. 일제강점기 충남 직산 광산에서 광부로 일하던 중 만세 시위를 주도하다가 순국한 김영호·김세철·남기석 선생에게도 건국훈장 애국장이 수여된다.)

item.title: Kim Tae-ho: "President Lee mentioned need for power-sharing constitutional reform even if it shortens his term" (김태호 “李, 임기 단축하더라도 분권형 개헌 필요 언급”)
item.description:
Kim Tae-ho: "President Lee mentioned need for power-sharing constitutional reform even if it shortens his term" (김태호 “李, 임기 단축하더라도 분권형 개헌 필요 언급”)

President Lee Jae-myung recently played golf rounds with multiple-term lawmakers from the People Power Party (PPP) and said regarding the proposal for "power-sharing structural constitutional reform" that "I think constitutional reform should be pursued even if it means shortening my term," PPP lawmaker Kim Tae-ho revealed on the 13th. This is the first time the president has been known to mention "shortening his term" since taking office. (이재명 대통령이 최근 국민의힘 다선 의원들과 잇따라 골프 라운딩을 하며 ‘분권형 권력 구조 개헌’ 제안에 대해 “내 임기를 단축해서라도 개헌을 해야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다고 김태호 국민의힘 의원이 13일 밝혔다. 대통령이 취임 뒤 자신의 ‘임기 단축’을 언급한 것이 알려진 것은 처음이다.)

President Lee and lawmaker Kim reportedly played a round together on the 4th of last month at a golf course in the capital area, accompanied by Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik and Democratic Party lawmakers. At that meeting, Kim reportedly first said, "The '87 system has outlived its usefulness, and the vicious cycle continues—former presidents going to prison whenever power changes hands—so for the future of the country, we need to create a power-sharing structure that divides power and responsibility." In response, President Lee reportedly went so far as to mention "shortening his term." In a phone call with this newspaper, Kim said, "The president was very actively sympathetic," adding, "But the president said, 'No matter how much I want it, if I publicly push for constitutional reform, it would actually backfire,' and that he hoped the momentum would form naturally at the National Assembly level." (이 대통령과 김 의원은 지난달 4일 수도권 한 골프장에서 강훈식 대통령 비서실장, 민주당 의원 등과 동반 라운딩을 한 것으로 알려졌다. 이 자리에서 김 의원이 먼저 “87 체제는 이제 수명을 다했고 정권이 바뀔 때마다 전직 대통령이 감옥에 가는 등 악순환이 계속되는 만큼 국가 장래를 위해 분권형 권력 구조로, 권력과 책임을 나누는 공존 구조를 만들어야 한다”고 말했고, 이에 이 대통령은 ‘임기 단축’까지 언급했다고 한다. 김 의원은 본지 통화에서 “대통령이 굉장히 적극적으로 공감하시더라”며 “그렇지만 대통령은 ‘아무리 하고 싶어도 내가 개헌하자고 말을 하면 오히려 안 되더라’며 국회 차원에서 자연스럽게 분위기가 형성되면 좋겠다고 말했다”고 전했다.)

President Lee had mentioned "shortening his term" for constitutional reform during the 2022 presidential election against former President Yoon Suk Yeol. However, he did not do so in the 2025 presidential election. At that time, President Lee had proposed "constitutional reform for a four-year, two-term presidency" as his campaign pledge, but now he has for the first time expressed support for "power-sharing structural constitutional reform." Power-sharing typically refers to a responsible prime minister system or a dual executive system. This has led to speculation in political circles that President Lee's views on restructuring the power structure and his term in office may have shifted. (이 대통령은 윤석열 전 대통령과의 지난 2022년 대선 때에는 개헌을 위한 ‘임기 단축’을 언급한 적이 있다. 하지만 2025년 대선에선 하지 않았다. 당시 이 대통령은 대선 공약으로 ‘대통령 4년 연임제 개헌’을 내세웠는데, 이번에 처음으로 ‘분권형 권력 구조 개헌’에도 찬성 입장을 밝힌 것이다. 분권형은 보통 책임 총리제, 이원집정부제 등을 말한다. 이 때문에 정치권에서는 이 대통령의 권력 구조 개편과 임기에 대한 생각이 변화한 것 아니냐는 말이 나왔다.)

Regarding concerns raised by some in the opposition about President Lee's potential "constitutional reform for re-election" and "dictatorship," Kim said, "President Lee responded, 'At South Korea's current level, does that even make sense?'" President Lee also reportedly said, "Constitutional amendment requires a quorum in the National Assembly, and if the PPP opposes it, it won't pass—so if I had such intentions, wouldn't I be unable to get constitutional reform through?" The required quorum for a constitutional amendment to pass—"approval by two-thirds of all National Assembly members"—means it would be impossible if even the 109 PPP lawmakers opposed it. (김 의원은 야권 일각에서 제기하는 이 대통령의 ‘연임 개헌’과 ‘독재’ 가능성에 대해서는 “이 대통령이 ‘대한민국의 지금 수준에서 그게 말이 되느냐’고 하더라”고 전했다. 이 대통령은 “헌법 개정을 위해서는 국회 정족수가 있는데 국민의힘이 반대하면 통과가 안 되는 것이니, 그런 의도가 있다면 개헌을 못 하는 것 아니냐”고도 말했다고 한다. 개헌안 국회 통과에 필요한 정족수인 ‘국회 재적 의원 3분의 2 찬성’은 국민의힘 소속 의원 109명만 반대해도 통과가 어려운 만큼 불가능하다는 의미다.)

However, shortly after the golf meeting between President Lee and Kim, National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik made controversial remarks about "constitutional reform for re-election" at the end of the same month, saying it was "a matter of the people's choice." Under the current Constitution, a sitting president cannot be re-elected, but his remarks were interpreted as suggesting that re-election constitutional reform for President Lee would be possible if there were national consensus. As the "re-election constitutional reform" controversy spread during the president's overseas trip, Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik and Senior Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo stepped forward to say, "The president stated that our constitutional system does not allow re-election, the public would not easily accept it, and it is realistically impossible." President Lee did not directly address it himself. (하지만 이 대통령과 김 의원의 골프 회동 직후인 같은 달 말 조정식 국회의장은 ‘연임 개헌’에 대해 “국민 선택의 문제”라고 언급해 논란이 된 바 있다. 현행 헌법상 현직 대통령의 연임은 불가능한데, 국민적 합의만 있으면 이 대통령의 연임 개헌도 가능하다는 취지로 해석됐다. 대통령의 순방 중에 ‘연임 개헌’ 논란이 확산하자, 강훈식 비서실장과 홍익표 정무수석이 나서서 “대통령은 우리나라 헌법 체계가 연임을 허용하지 않고, 국민도 쉽게 용인하지 않을 것이며, 현실적으로 불가능하다고 말씀하셨다”고 했다. 이 대통령이 직접 언급은 하지 않았다.)

It has been reported that President Lee has recently been playing golf rounds on weekends with lawmakers from both the ruling and opposition parties. Lawmaker Kim Tae-ho said, "I had a very candid, extensive conversation with President Lee" and "He was surprisingly down-to-earth. It's very meaningful that ruling and opposition members can share such a space together." However, the presidential office only said regarding the golf meeting and the president's remarks on constitutional reform, "It is difficult to confirm private schedules and private remarks." (최근 이 대통령은 주말에 여야 의원들과 골프 라운딩을 하는 것으로 알려졌다. 김태호 의원은 “이 대통령과 굉장히 담백하게 많은 이야기를 나눴다”며 “의외로 소탈하시더라. 여야가 그렇게 함께하는 공간을 갖는 것은 굉장히 의미가 있다”고 했다. 다만 청와대는 골프 회동과 이 대통령의 개헌 관련 언급에 대해 “비공개 일정, 비공개 발언은 확인이 어렵다”고만 했다.)

President Lee is also known to have played golf with former and current Democratic Party floor leadership, including Han Byung-do, acting party leader and floor leader, and Park Chan-dae, current mayor of Incheon. After the National Assembly's organization was completed in June, he reportedly had golf meetings with former Deputy Speaker Joo Ho-young and current Deputy Speaker Park Deok-heum of the PPP. National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik, who comes from the Democratic Party, also participated. Rep. Shin Sung-bum, a senior PPP lawmaker who served as chair of the National Assembly Intelligence Committee, also received a golf meeting invitation, and other PPP lawmakers reportedly received offers as well. (이 대통령은 한병도 민주당 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표, 박찬대 현 인천시장 등 전현직 민주당 원내지도부와도 골프를 친 것으로 알려졌다. 지난 6월 국회 원 구성이 마무리된 뒤엔 국민의힘 소속 주호영 전 국회부의장, 박덕흠 현 국회부의장과 함께 골프 회동을 했다고 한다. 민주당 출신 조정식 국회의장도 함께했다. 국회 정보위원장을 맡았던 국민의힘 중진 신성범 의원도 골프 회동 제안을 받았고, 다른 국민의힘 의원들에게도 회동 제안이 있었던 것으로 전해졌다.)

President Lee's golf skills are also said to have improved considerably. At the G7 summit held in France in June, President Lee mentioned receiving a "golf round" proposal from U.S. President Donald Trump, saying, "I think I need to prepare." Since it would be a "couples' golf" outing with First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, both the president and first lady have reportedly been practicing golf. A source in the ruling camp said, "President Lee's golf was quite decent before, around 90 strokes, but his skills seemed to have declined after not picking up clubs through several elections," adding, "To be precise, his skills aren't improving—he's 'recovering' to his previous level." (이 대통령의 골프 실력도 상당히 향상된 것으로 전해졌다. 이 대통령은 지난 6월 프랑스에서 열린 G7 정상회의에서 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령으로부터 ‘골프 라운딩’ 제안을 받았다며 “준비를 해야 할 것 같다”고 했었다. 김혜경 여사와 함께하는 ‘부부 동반 골프’여서 대통령 부부가 모두 골프 연습을 하는 것으로 알려졌었다. 여권 관계자는 “이 대통령이 과거엔 골프 실력이 90타대로 꽤 괜찮았지만 여러 선거를 치르면서 골프채를 잡지 않아 실력이 떨어졌던 것 같다”며 “정확히는 골프 실력이 는 것이 아니라 예전 실력으로 ‘회복’되고 있는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil apologizes for "Jeong Cheong-rae's goldfish IQ" remark... "Not the words to use for a comrade" (송영길, “정청래 붕어 IQ” 발언 사과...“동지에 쓸 말 아냐”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil apologizes for "Jeong Cheong-rae's goldfish IQ" remark... "Not the words to use for a comrade" (송영길, “정청래 붕어 IQ” 발언 사과...“동지에 쓸 말 아냐”)

Song Young-gil, a candidate in the upcoming Democratic Party of Korea leadership race, apologized for his previous day's remark in which he criticized fellow candidate Jeong Cheong-rae as having a "goldfish IQ." (더불어민주당 차기 당대표 선거에 출마한 송영길 후보가 정청래 후보를 ‘붕어 IQ’라고 비난한 전날 자신의 발언에 대해 사과했다.)

In a Facebook post on the 14th, Song said, "These were not the words to use for a comrade in the same party," adding, "I also express my regret to party members who may have felt uncomfortable." (송 후보는 14일 페이스북 글에서 “같은 당의 동지에게 쓸 말은 아니었다”면서 “마음 불편하셨을 당원 동지 여러분께도 유감의 뜻을 전한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the background of the "goldfish IQ" remark, Song said, "Candidate Jeong Cheong-rae has been claiming that 'the party, government, and presidential office agreed to define the last local elections as a victory.' However, in the final TV debate, he changed his words, saying it was the party and presidential office, not the party, government, and presidential office." He added, "My emotions flared up at the sight of him lying in the face of clear facts, and in that process, an excessive expression slipped out. Still, I regret that the language was too harsh." (송 후보는 ‘붕어 IQ’ 발언 경위에 대해 “정청래 후보는 그동안 ‘당·정·청이 협의해 지난 지방선거를 승리로 규정했다’고 주장했다”면서 “그런데 마지막 TV 토론에서는 당·정·청이 아니라 당·청이라고 했다며 말을 바꿨다”고 했다. 이어 “명백한 사실 앞에서 거짓말을 하는 모습에 감정이 격해졌고, 그 과정에서 과한 표현이 나왔다”면서 “그럼에도 표현이 거칠었던 것은 유감스럽게 생각한다”고 했다.)

The previous day, in a CBS radio interview, Song had criticized Jeong, saying, "The video is preserved as evidence, so why tell such an obvious lie? It's not like he has a goldfish IQ." At the time, Song said, "To lie, you need to be smart. You have to remember everything you said before, but since he can't remember, it's like he has a goldfish IQ." (송 후보는 전날 CBS라디오 인터뷰에서 정 후보를 향해 “영상이 박제가 돼 있는데 뻔한 거짓말을 왜 하느냐. 붕어 IQ도 아니고”라고 비난했다. 당시 송 후보는 “거짓말을 하려면 머리가 좋아야 한다”면서 “이전에 자기가 무슨 말을 하는지를 다 기억하고 있어야 하는데 그 기억을 못 하니까 붕어 IQ처럼”이라고 했다.)

In a Facebook post, Jeong fired back, saying, "Last time, he didn't hesitate to use extreme words like 'traitor' and 'cut off his head,' and now it's 'goldfish IQ'—isn't this going too far?" He added, "Did Kim Min-seok put him up to it? Or is this Song Young-gil's unique character?" (정 후보는 페이스북 글에서 “지난번에는 ‘역적’ ‘목 잘라야’라는 극언을 서슴지 않더니 이제 ‘붕어 IQ’까지, 이거 너무 심하지 않느냐”면서 “김민석이 시켰나? 아니면 송영길의 독특한 인간성인가”라고 맞받았다.)
